items.title: Adobe expects Black Friday online sales of $12.9 billion, growing faster than Cyber Monday
items.summary: Adobe's holiday forecast puts U.S. online spending at a record $275.1 billion for November and December, with the deepest discounts during Cyber Week.

items.title: Walmart's first Black Friday deals event starts November 12
items.summary: Walmart is running three holiday sale events this year: early deals Nov. 12 to 15, Black Friday deals Nov. 23 to 29 and Cyber Monday deals Nov. 30 to Dec. 2.

items.title: Spotify reaches 306 million paying subscribers and 788 million users
items.summary: Spotify's third-quarter results show growth in every region, with revenue of 5.0 billion euros and operating income ahead of its own forecast.

items.title: Pikmin 4 Switch 2 Edition with Dandori Academy arrives November 12
items.summary: Nintendo's upgraded Pikmin 4 adds sharper visuals, voice commands for Oatchi and a 72-stage challenge mode released over time.

items.title: Football Manager 27 is out on PC, consoles, Netflix and Apple Arcade
items.summary: Sports Interactive released all four versions of FM27 on November 10, including through Game Pass, Netflix and Apple Arcade subscriptions.

items.title: Chrome 157 update fixes a flaw Google says is being exploited
items.summary: Google's November 9 desktop update patches nine security bugs, including a high-severity use-after-free in Chrome's XML code with a known exploit.

items.title: Windows 11 November update KB5132061 turns on NTLM signing by default
items.summary: Microsoft's November security update for Windows 11 tightens NTLM and PowerShell script signing and fixes USB audio and printer bugs.

items.title: Home improvement spending expected to stay flat through late 2027
items.summary: Harvard's remodeling forecast projects 1.5% growth to about $527 billion, citing flat building-product sales and stalled remodeling permits.

items.title: EIA: heating oil bills to rise 21% this winter while natural gas bills fall 9%
items.summary: The federal energy agency's winter outlook splits sharply by fuel, so what a household pays depends on how the home is heated.

items.title: Homes for sale rose 7.4% in October as contract signings fell 17%
items.summary: Realtor.com's October report shows more listings sitting on the market and fewer buyers signing contracts as mortgage rates held above 7%.

items.title: Skydance plans a combined Paramount+ and HBO Max streamer for early 2027
items.summary: The company told shareholders the merged service would come at one price. It did not give the price.

items.title: Denver launches an AI tool that pre-checks building permit applications
items.summary: StartSmart flags missing items before an application goes to city staff. Staff still make the final call.

items.title: OpenAI agrees to acquire Pierre, maker of Code Storage, to build out Codex
items.summary: Pierre's open-source developer libraries will stay open source, and current Code Storage customers can keep using it after the deal closes.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI is 10 days out: what to know about the Nov. 19 launch
items.summary: Rockstar's release date has held since it moved from May, making it the biggest game launch of the holiday season.

items.title: Mortgage rates dip to 7.18% in Freddie Mac's Nov. 5 survey
items.summary: The 30-year fixed average fell for a third straight week, but it is still almost a full point above where it sat a year ago.

items.title: Existing-home sales rose 1.5% in September as inventory climbed
items.summary: NAR counted a 3.99 million annual sales pace, with the median price up 1.3% from a year earlier to $417,500.

items.title: NRF forecasts 2026 holiday sales will top $1 trillion
items.summary: The retail trade group expects November and December sales to grow 4.2% over 2025, with up to 375,000 seasonal hires.
